findings.claim: For a shared field, the active UI direction is to add it to the owned @repo/ui/components/native and @repo/ui/components/web packages with matching props; browser web uses browser-native DOM components.

The current API direction is Sanctuary API with native oRPC v2 procedures targeting /api/v1; clients must not add new direct .from(), .rpc(), or realtime database paths, and new code must not import frozen pre-v1 @repo/core/api/*.

Before adding an API procedure, the current rules require following the domain design method, including a <domain>.<subdomain> namespace and a subdomain card; capabilities belong in the catalog and have a card.

The older workflow's tRPC, Supabase migration, Zustand source-of-truth, and packages/ui or packages/core prescriptions conflict with the current API and package boundaries and should be revised before implementation.

The older workflow requires an explicit user approval of its pre-compilation plan. The active platform rules prescribe a cognitive order before code but do not state that same approval gate, so whether to retain that gate requires an explicit policy decision.
